answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 22668 Country: India Title: We have 19 tola gold since 17.02.2002 to till date.Kindly calculatethe adjuct amount of zakat to till date. Question: We have 19 tola gold since 17.02.2002 to till date.Kindly calculatethe adjuct amount of zakat to till date. Answer ID: 22668 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 948/696/L=1431) Get the Arabic date of the above mentioned day and pay the zakah of total years according to the Arabic calendar. And pay the zakah after evaluating the price of each year's gold, for first year pay the zakah of complete wealth and for the next years pay the zakah by deducting the quantity of wajib. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
